description: A stochastic oscillator after Xenakis's GENDY3: a piecewise-linear waveform whose breakpoints each take a random walk every cycle, so the pitch and the timbre drift together.

params.text: Sets how many breakpoints make up one cycle of the waveform, 2 to 64.
Scales how far the amplitude walk moves a breakpoint each cycle, 0 to 1, which sets the rate of timbral change.
Scales how far the duration walk moves a breakpoint each cycle, 0 to 1, which sets the rate of the glissandi.
Sets the amplitude barrier the walk reflects off, 0 to 1; 0 freezes the amplitudes and 1 opens the full ±5V swing.
Sets the centre frequency the segment durations are built around, 20Hz to 5000Hz; the default 261.63Hz is C4.
Sets how far the segment durations may open either side of the centre frequency, 0 to 1; at 0 the pitch is fixed.
Chooses which distribution the random draws come from: Cauchy, Gaussian, Uniform or Logistic.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the amplitude step scale.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the duration step scale.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the amplitude barrier.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the duration barrier width.
Sets how many cycles a breakpoint's step keeps its direction: 0% gives uncorrelated jitter, the default 30% about 16 cycles, 100% long steady glides.
Scales the durations of every cycle so the measured period tracks the centre frequency while the waveform keeps changing shape; the switch comes up off.

inputs.text: Modulates the amplitude step scale, at a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the duration step scale, at a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the amplitude barrier, at a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the duration barrier width, at a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.

outputs.text: The oscillator's audio, ±5V, with a 5Hz high-pass removing the walk's slow drift.
A 10V trigger 1ms long at the end of every completed waveform cycle.
The frequency of the most recently completed cycle as 1V/octave, 0V for C4, clamped to ±5V.

notes: The waveform drawn at the top is the current breakpoints of one cycle, redrawn about 45 times a second rather than every cycle.
The evolved breakpoints are saved with the patch, so a sound left to run reloads with the shape it had.
menu: Initial waveform: Sine, Triangle, Saw, Square, Random — chooses the shape the breakpoints are seeded from and re-seeds at once; the four deterministic shapes start on the exact centre pitch.
Re-seed waveform — re-seeds the breakpoints from the chosen initial waveform.
